verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm Stripe serves a live llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt containing agent-directed guidance. They also confirm markdown versions of the crypto docs (e.g., crypto.md), and the stablecoin pages are consistently available as .md URLs an agent can consume. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt specifically indexes the crypto/stablecoin section, and first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs feature itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.stripe.com/llms.txt # Stripe Documentation
